opus.problem: The quote 'Your people will be my people, and your God will be my God', together with 'Moabite widow', is the best-known line tied to Ruth. This one clue gives the word away, so it is not medium hard.
Naomi had only two daughters-in-law. Naming Orpah and asking for 'this other daughter-in-law' leaves only Ruth, so this one clue gives the word away.
